target: Paisaje de navegación de La Orilla Partida en el Camino de la Tierra Húmeda.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Punto donde el sendero terrestre se divide entre pasarela y terreno firme; el agua ya condiciona claramente el movimiento.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Create a wide landscape of La Orilla Partida. A damp terrestrial route reaches a shallow wetland edge and visibly divides: one branch continues over firmer raised ground while a simple narrow wooden walkway carries the other across waterlogged terrain. Reeds, muddy channels and low water occupy more of the scene than at Los Primeros Juncos, but this is still a route transition rather than open lake. Composition must make the fork and two viable directions immediately readable.
negative_constraints: No major bridge, dock, village or invented buildings
No ocean, beach or mangrove aesthetic
No magical mist, glow or fantasy ruins
No confusing maze of many paths; exactly one clear split
No characters or creatures as focal subject
